from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs/task-bbe45ceb.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
s='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and g[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if g[y][x] != 0]
            if not colored:
                continue
            y0, y1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            ty0, ty1 = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            tx0, tx1 = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            th, tw = ty1-ty0+1, tx1-tx0+1
            motif = [row[tx0:tx1+1] for row in g[ty0:ty1+1]]
            for y in range(y0, y1+1):
                for x in range(x0, x1+1):
                    g[y][x] = motif[(y-ty0) % th][(x-tx0) % tw]
    return g
'''
